bio: There's plenty to like here: The trendy concept not only covers lunch and dinner, but also breakfast, plus it has a café with pastries and delicatessen items. The space is modern and exudes a bistro flair; the open kitchen, in which seasonal dishes and smaller plates are rustled up, tends to draw the eye. The game dishes and the items cooked on the Josper grill, for example, are interesting options. Reasonably priced lunch....
